caption:
Love the colors in a photo? 🎨 Turn them into a palette you can use.

1. Open image.315tools.com and tap Colors
2. Add your photo
3. The main colors appear, each with a HEX code
4. Tap a color to copy it, or tap Copy as CSS

Free · No sign-up · No upload ✅
